name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: Events in the order they happened.
use: A record of what happened: an activity feed, a deployment's history, a changelog. Its length is open and every event is done. Write it as an ol, with a time element for each moment.

instead.when: It is a fixed sequence a reader moves through, with one step current and the rest ahead
The rows are things, not moments, and their order carries no time
The steps are work under way that may be running or have failed, and open to show what stands behind them

classes.name: timeline-item
classes.description: An event; a hairline joins its marker to the next

classes.name: timeline-marker
classes.description: A small dot when empty, or a small well around an icon

classes.name: timeline-time
classes.description: When it happened, in tabular figures

states.name: current
states.description: The newest event, or the one a reader is at: an empty marker's dot takes ink and a faint halo

example:
1. Deployed to production

    atlas.dev is live in 14 regions.

    2 minutes ago

  2. Build completed

    38 routes compiled in 48 seconds.

    3 minutes ago
